learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of the main experimental methods and approaches (measurement of forces, displacements, velocities, vibrations, flow rates, pressures, temperature, etc.) used in the field of mechanical engineering.
Familiarization with experimental methods used in the field of mechanical engineering.
Correct understanding of the evolution of applying experimental methods in mechanical engineering.
Acquisition of the mechanical behavior of experimental methods (apparatus) used in the field of mechanical engineering.
Acquisition of the necessary knowledge regarding the execution of experimental measurements specific to the discipline.
Ability to operate with scientific or engineering fundamentals related to experimental measurements.

syllabus_topics: Experimental methods used in mechanical engineering
Occupational safety and health (OSH) and fire protection (PSI) norms + Laboratory presentation
Measurement of temperature and determination of surface quality
Measurement of pressures and flow rates

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (2 theory topics, 1 practical topic using a laboratory measuring device)
Written test verifying laboratory work content and execution

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a written exam (60%) and a written test for laboratory activities (40%). The written exam assesses knowledge of experimental methods, device descriptions, mechanical behavior, and methodology. The laboratory test assesses knowledge of the purpose, content, and methodology of laboratory work. A minimum performance standard requires general knowledge of apparatus/devices used in mechanical engineering, acquisition of fundamental notions, and the ability to define main types of experimental methods.
